title: Public Report Schema
description: A formal report an organization makes public, such as an annual report, a valuation, a privacy policy or a market announcement: its type, version, lifecycle status, the person or team that issues it, and the mandatory disclosures it contains. Public reports give an auditable record of what was disclosed, when, and under whose authority.

publicReportID.description: Unique identifier for the report, e.g. PR-VAL-001

title.description: Short, descriptive name of the report

issuingStakeholderTitle.description: Person or team responsible for issuing the report

orgUnitID.description: Organization unit that owns the report

publishedDate.description: Date the report was made public

lodgedWithExternalOrgID.description: Regulator, exchange or registry the report was lodged with, if any

statementOfComplianceIDs.description: Statements of compliance published in the report

reportType.description: Formal type of a public report. aiDisclosure = a report or section whose purpose is to disclose the organization's use of AI or automated decision-making

reportStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a public report: draft (in preparation), approved (internally approved), published (made public), cancelled (publication formally stopped), withdrawn (removed after publication)

examples.title: Technical Assessment & Valuation Report
examples.description: A valuation of the company's mineral assets as of Q3 2025.
